99
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, February 11, 2014/Magha 22, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Power)
Total number of questions — 20
Faulty weather radars on A320
aircrafts
*281. DR. T. N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has received
representation from pilots' association
belonging to Air India that if the existing
weather radars fitted on A320 aircrafts are
not replaced they could result in major
accidents;
(b) the details of the defect reports filed
by pilots pointing out the faulty weather
radars;
(c) whether this defect is also costing
the airline in terms of money and delays
because pilots tend to divert the plane on a
circuitous route in order to be extra cautious
to avoid clouds; and
(d) if so, the action taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to solve this
major problem?
Usages of virtual currencies
*282. DR. CHANDAN MITRA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has examined
the issues associated with the usages,
holding and trading of virtual currencies
including bitcoins under the extant legal and
regulatory framework of the country, if so,
the details thereof;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the remedial measures taken by
Government in the matter keeping in view
the use of these virtual currencies in money
laundering, terror financing, etc.?
Consumption of power/electricity in
the country
*283. SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount of power/electricity
consumed annually in the country vis-a-
vis other developed countries of the world;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
ensure the power/electricity security of the
country;
(c) whether Government proposes to
provide minimum electricity to the entire
population in the country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
being taken in this regard?

100
Revival of sick CPSUs
*284. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) the total number of sick Central
Public Sector Units (CPSUs) with location,
State-wise;
(b) the total amount of statutory dues
payable to the employees of these PSUs
and details thereof;
(c) the number of these CPSUs which
have been referred to the Board for
Reconstruction of Public Sector Enterprises
(BRPSE) for revival;
(d) whether there is any time-bound
action plan for revival of these units, if so,
the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Production of crude oil in the country
*285. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of surveys undertaken
for exploration of oil and natural gas by the
different public and private sector
companies in the country;
(b) the details of exploration works
completed by these companies;
(c) the details of crude oil extracted
during the last five years and current year;
and
(d) the details of commercial production
of crude oil during this period?
Non-issuance of medicines by CGHS
dispensaries
*286. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CGHS
beneficiaries, who visit the OPDs of CGHS
empanelled hospitals on their own are not
issued medicines by CGHS dispensaries
on the prescription of doctors of these
hospitals;
(b) if so, what are the norms in this
regard; and
(c) whether Government will direct the
CMOs of CGHS dispensaries to issue
medicines to the beneficiaries, particularly
senior citizens who are unable to stand in
long queues of Government hospitals?
Healthcare programme for rural
children
*287. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has started any
new scheme in the States for rural kids who
are considered to be the most vulnerable
from point of view of healthcare;
(b) if so, the details thereof and funds
spent for this purpose during the Eleventh
and Twelfth Plan periods, State-wise; and
(c) if not, by when such a new scheme
will be implemented for rural kids?
Aadhaar linked LPG distribution
scheme
*288. SHRI K. N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
introduce Aadhaar linked LPG distribution
scheme in different States;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme and
the present position thereof;
(c) whether Government has any plan
to roll out the scheme on a pan-India basis;
(d) if so, the present position and time-
frame to fulfil it; and

101
(e) whether any complaints have been
received by Government on the
implementation of the scheme and if so,
action taken thereon?
Response of Swiss Banks on black
mon

532
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, February 11, 2014/Magha 22, 1935 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Power)
Total number of questions — 155
New airports in the country
†2022. SHRI THAAW AR CHAND
GEHLOT: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
proposals from States to establish and
develop new airports in their respective
territories;
(b) if so, the details of the proposals
received during the last three years, State-
wise; and
(c) the names of the States in which
Government has decided to establish new
airports and develop certain other airports;
and the details of such airports, State-wise?
Air connectivity in the
country
2023. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has chalked
out any long term plan to connect small
towns, remote and interior areas of the
country with air services;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether Government has initiated
any process to identify such small towns,
remote and interior areas in the country;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Air safety norms
2024. SHRI S. THANGA VELU:
SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has sought six more months to comply with
air safety norms and other corrective
measures issued by the Federal Aviation
Administration (FAA);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the FAA
has threatened to downgrade India's air
safety ranking after it conducted an audit
of the Directorate General of Civil Aviation
(DGCA) in December, 2013; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

533
Purchase of SAP from IBM
2025. SHRI AMBETH RAJAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
purchased System Application Programme
(SAP) from IBM at an exorbitant price of
` 200 crores, which is available at ` 2 to 5
crores;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether above SAP purchased by
Government will include all the applications
meant for Civil Aviation viz., Haj
Pilgrimage, reservation in employment to
SC/ST; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of staff in ANS
department
2026. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the functioning of the Air
Navigation System (ANS) department is
facing problems due to an acute shortage of
staff;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether around 150 cases have been
reported of situations where two aircrafts
came dangerously close to each other in
mid-air, reflecting the seriousness of the
staff shortage in ANS department;
and
(d) the action plan formulated by
Government to deal with such problems
and to fill the vacant posts within a
prescribed time frame?
Operation of A-380 aircraft in the
country
2027. SHRI S. THANGA VELU: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India
(AI) is headed for further trouble as
Government plans to open foreign routes
to new domestic airlines and allow giant
Airbus A-380s of foreign airlines to land at
domestic airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Air
India has objected for allowing A-380
aircraft operations in India; and
(d) if so, the view of Government in
this regard?
Domestic airlines to fly abroad
2028. DR. K.P. RAMALINGAM: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering for abolition of the five year/
20 aircraft rule, which prevents domestic
airlines from flying abroad until they have
been operating in the domestic route for
five years and have a fleet size of at least
20 aircrafts;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government wants this rule to be changed
because no such restriction applies
to foreign airlines operating into India;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

534
Safety of air passengers
2029. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that aircrafts of
private airlines which were not equipped
with CAT-III, were allowed to land during
foggy weather at Delhi and other airports
in North India during this winter season;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the Aviation Authority has
taken cognizance of such airlines;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken by Government in
this regard to ensure safety of air
passengers?
Dropping of voluntary retirement
scheme in Air India
2030. SHRI T.M. SELVAGANA-
PATHI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to stat
